reference_amendment: The independent v2 convergence audit found a 0.36% primitive RMS disagreement for Shu--Osher and 2.42% for Woodward--Colella between 2048 and 4096 cells. The final Woodward--Colella reference was therefore raised to 4096 cells. The model, cases, metrics, comparator grids, sensor, and checkpoints were unchanged.
